resources.string: One dedicated conversation that keeps memories of your time together
Stay in one conversation,\nand keep chatting.

One character, one chat window
Once created, this character stays in the same conversation without opening a second window.

Remember what matters in your time together
Agent character memories organize preferences, experiences and promises. You can view and edit them, or check them against the original messages. They are stored separately from regular character memories and global Agent memories.

Bring over an existing conversation
On the creation page, select an existing character and then the conversation to transfer. Configure a model and convert the conversation to create a new copy. The original character and conversation are preserved.

Use tools when needed
Configured and available Agent tools can still be used while chatting. Models and tools may incur provider charges.
